grid: For each strength/source-count/stability/bonus/gap tuple, include one count=0,kind=none row and all count=1,2,4 x kind=hypothesis,sensory,reward rows;1080 cells
graph: Exactly three Sparks in every arm: target hypothesis, independent zero-state hypothesis, zero-state sensory Spark. No edges, listeners, plasticity, or initial activation; high threshold prevents firing.
evidence: Two distinct evidence IDs on the same target hypothesis at fixed times and equal strength. Only metadata.sensor differs between source-count1 and2. All arms share identical genuine evidence bytes within the source/strength condition.
padding: Schedule each padding event after both genuine events are processed. Times t=.01+gap*k for k=1..count. Strength0, no evidence_id, origin_kind=internal. Hypothesis/sensory arms use PROPAGATION to the corresponding unrelated Spark. Reward uses REWARD target=None. Same explicit priority10. Run to empty after each event.
horizon: After every arm including no padding, inject zero REWARD target=None at .01+4*gap and run to empty. This aligns final engine time without triggering Coalition evaluation; it does not synchronize last Coalition evaluation.
initial_hypothesis: Unrelated hypothesis padding may advance global incumbent stability and its coherence score, causing first ignition without changing external evidence. This is a source-motivated prediction, not an observed result.
primary_comparisons: kind=hypothesis versus sensory and reward at same count/gap
PRIMARY gap0, bonus0, strength.6, sources2, stability4 isolates hard stability gate; first-ignition onset only
bonus.06 versus0, strength.43, sources2, stability2 isolates near-threshold coherence contribution
gap0 versus positive gap separates event count from elapsed decay
null_controls: single source with same two IDs/events
strong evidence stability1/2 may already ignite before padding
gap1 may allow decay to prevent a would-be ignition
one-source pure diversity interpretation is restricted to strength.6; strength.43 also loses diversity bonus
raw_contract: Retain cell/config, exact full graph parameters and all inputs, observation after each event (raw incumbent Coalition, stability, evidence records, projected state at current time, new Ignitions, counters), final workspace/coalitions and every named metric. Record null if no ignition. Projected data is labeled observer-only and never fed to runtime.
measurement: Inspection must not invoke evaluation, snapshot recording, or touch. Pure read of dataclass state and analytic projection only; verify serialized state unchanged across observer use. Last-coalition data retains its actual last-evaluation time, distinct from final horizon.
comparability: One unmodified engine, identical three Sparks and zero edges per arm. Padding count adds actual events/work; controls at same count match event count but not executed Spark updates. No compute superiority inference.
analysis: Per-cell results and exact matched contrasts only. Cells are deterministic constructed cases, not independent samples; no p-values, population rates, confidence intervals, or seed-as-replication inference.
stopping_rule: Publish frozen protocol and source checkpoint before full grid. Execute exact grid, preserve all/null/negative outcomes, reproduce in a second fresh process at PYTHONHASHSEED1 and37. No outcome-based retuning. Any experimental choice change requires new protocol. Implementation failure retains failed artifact provenance.
claims: Only bounded legacy gate behavior; no runtime fix/defect assertion, formal identity, promotion, v03/v032/v05/M1 inference, biological/novelty/energy/performance claim.
collision: Main18ff183; AnalystR177; ControlR153. ActivePR164/M1 and FLY-0 remain untouched. No PROJECT_STATUS, scheduler/control, official artifacts, or formal refs changed.
numeric_policy: Preserve exact engine gate comparisons. Any independent analytic consistency check uses absolute tolerance1e-9; never apply tolerance to decide engine ignition.
